Here are the pairwise API composition constraints:

RELATION: param-dependency | APIS: make_first_score_manager, sp.hooks.score | RULE: The score hook result mode (FIRST) determines the return type of hooks.score(value).  
RELATION: param-dependency | APIS: make_last_score_manager, sp.hooks.score | RULE: The score hook result mode (LAST) determines the return type of hooks.score(value).  
RELATION: return-flow | APIS: sp.plugins_context, sp.hooks.score | RULE: hooks.score(value) must be called within the plugins_context(plugins) block to use the temporary plugin state.  
RELATION: shared-receiver | APIS: sp.disable, sp.enable | RULE: disable(*names) and enable(*names) must act on the same Simplug manager instance.  
RELATION: shared-receiver | APIS: wrapper.disable, wrapper.enable | RULE: disable() and enable() must act on the same plugin wrapper instance.  
RELATION: lifecycle | APIS: sp.plugins_context, sp.hooks.score | RULE: hooks.score(value) must be called while the plugins_context(plugins) context is active.  
RELATION: completion-obligation | APIS: sp.plugins_context, sp.hooks.score | RULE: hooks.score(value) must be called before exiting the plugins_context(plugins) block to use the temporary plugin state.
